project_type.description: The entry type whose people get thanked when an entry is published (projects, pieces, releases).

people_field.description: The field on that entry type that names the people who helped, as the last part of each person's entry web address, separated by commas.

person_type.description: The entry type used for people (collaborators, makers, guests).

consent_field.description: The yes/no field on a person that is ticked when they are happy to be tagged. Anyone without it ticked is left out.

handle_field.description: The field on a person that holds the handle to tag, such as `@ada@mastodon.social`.

draft_entry_type.description: The entry type the thank-you post is drafted as.

draft_body_field.description: The text field on that entry type where the post goes.
